author: hasl
body:
Dear Midnite,

So after talking to numerous senior staff members I finally managed to discover my ban was a one-man decision which was then discussed with two other senior mods. I've also found out the leaking included me poking Kiwi and Zegita the link to a two year old junior mod review sheet I was given before I was staff which half the community has, which in my eyes shouldn't be affected by policy 2.4, and the adjectives Para used against me in our fallout.

So before either of you reply saying 'We followed the policy' think... I got that spreadsheet in 2014 (from Peachy) before I was staff and poked Zegita and Kiwi it after I got demoted, not like half the community has access to that.

About saying what words Para used, they hit me real deep, being called: shit, leaking, abusing, worthless and DEAD, is not something I'm just going to take in. Before either of you say 'he called your rank dead', he didn't. You can't say 'not our fault you can't control your emotions' imagine how you'd feel if you were in my shoes, you both were online when it happened.

Me: Yeah, I probably am going to get demoted, and you'll laugh.
Para: Nah, I don't laugh at the dead...

The whole mod team can read this and they should be allowed to, the amount of time people have leaked worse things and have simply been demoted is something to consider too. Several staff members have done worse and some are in fact on the staff team currently.

Finally, I didn't say anything as bad or even come close to the words used above, I was just sarcastic and salty, I never insulted or made fun of certain things.

Regards,
Aura

replies.body:
Hello Aura,

I have taken the decision to appeal your ban. I trust you in saying that this was an old spreadsheet. In addition, you managed to talk to Para, and smoothen things out. I respect this, and think it should be rewarded. Welcome back, and good luck in the upcoming tournament.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
